properties.name: North trunk fill (Ludlow to ground)
properties.note: ten tracks on fill north of Ludlow (Transvalley, APEx Dayton, APEx Norwood, ORR, RER B), bent up to 18 m west to clear the OH-75 parkway: 162.5 m over Ludlow, level through the Northside / Spring Grove (B) platforms to s 5,570, then 1.5% down to ground at about s 6,270 (about 901 m). Retaining walls or slopes not drawn; no street crosses it

properties.name: Transvalley flyover (over APEx Dayton)
properties.note: Transvalley holds 162.5 m where the trunk comes down off the fill, crosses over the APEx Dayton pair (8.7 m or more rail to rail) and falls 2.5% to ground by about s 6,720, between the APEx pairs; fill or viaduct, not set

properties.name: RER B and ORR X2 flyover (over the Norwood tracks)
properties.note: B and X2 climb 2.5% from s 8,208 to 7.3 m over the APEx Norwood, ORR and Transvalley tracks where the Dayton line curves away north, back at ground by s 9,167

properties.name: Ludlow underbridge
properties.note: the trunk over Ludlow Avenue at ground (155.4 m), rail 162.5 m, about 26 degrees of skew, so the span runs well over 100 m along the tracks; the RER B Northside / Spring Grove platforms start at its north edge
